WANDIMOD-VENGEANCE_POWER.title: Vengeance
WANDIMOD-VENGEANCE_POWER.description:
Whenever Wandi loses HP, he gains 1 Vengeance.
Each stack of Vengeance increases his attack damage by 2%.
